question: Does the current cheap TRELLIS route preserve the official example's small, directionally organized cloak clumps that are closer to the generated cat-fur failure class?

source.role: official TRELLIS.2 dense fine-clump fur cloak example

conditionalHigherFaceRoute.runOnlyIf: exactCheapRoute visibly collapses or merges the source cloak clumps

decisionRule.ifExactIsClean: stop; higher settings are disfavored and source fur organization becomes the leading cat-fur failure explanation
decisionRule.ifExactIsDegraded: run the conditional higher-face route on this exact source before changing any other setting
decisionRule.ifHigherFacesImprove: face budget or simplification is causally implicated
decisionRule.ifHigherFacesDoNotImprove: face budget is not sufficient; only then test official-like stage quality

claimCeiling: One official fine-clump example can distinguish cheap-route preservation from visible fine-clump degradation. It cannot establish production reliability across fur types or prove that face budget is irrelevant to every source.
